docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Discourse on Method and the Meditations.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

René Descartes (1596–1650), the Discourse on Method and the Meditations, in the English translation of John Veitch (1829–1894), 1901. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
